about: The radio's stations. The game downloads each station's episodes by itself, over Wi-Fi, into a folder per station beside the saves, and plays them in order. To add a station, add an entry: its name (what the game shows), and where its episodes come from: an Internet Archive item ("archive", all its audio, or the "episodes" chosen from it by "file"), a podcast feed ("rss"), or "episodes" with a "url" each. An episode can name its own "archive" item, and a "match" in place of a "file": a piece of the file's name there (letters and digits, case ignored), for items whose exact names are long. A feed's "newest" keeps only that many of its newest episodes. "n" is an episode's number in the show; the game plays by it.

stations.name: Radio Kafr El-Sheikh
stations.source: Mohamed Andeel's show (2012-2017), as a fan archived it; aired order from TheTVDB; حلقة عبكويم is not in its list, so it has no number and plays last. Episodes 1, 3-7, 10, 11, 18, 27 and 28 are not in the archive.

stations.name: Coast to Coast AM
stations.source: George Noory's late-night call-in show: aliens, ghosts, cryptids, prophecy and the people who call in about them. The game reads the show's own free podcast feed (The Best of Coast to Coast AM, from Premiere Networks and iHeartPodcasts) as any podcast app does, and keeps only the newest 10 episodes, deleting older ones as new ones come.
